items.summary: Autodesk walked into its Q3 2027 earnings with the stock already under pressure, down over the past quarter and week, and then took another hit as the share price fell 3.5% on the day. The knee jerk reaction came even as the software maker posted roughly US$2.2b in quarterly revenue and about US$2.69 in basic earnings per share, both pointing to a strong profit engine. The real story sits in profitability. Trailing twelve month net income from continuing operations reached about US$1.86b,...

items.title: Autodesk earnings analysis: questions answered and next catalysts
items.summary: Investing.com -- Autodesk Inc (ADSK) beat on every headline line in fiscal Q3 2027, reported Nov 24, 2026. Even so, the stock opened lower. It was $249.67 (-2.36%) as of Nov 25, 3:08 PM EST, after trading as low as $241.98 pre-market. Shares closed at $255.70 before the report. Revenue was $2.16B against a $2.13B estimate. EPS was $3.20 against $3.07 (+4.23%). Non-GAAP operating margin reached 39%.
